subject.title: fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests

question: Should ClickClack permanently enforce a 30-second completion deadline for all non-multipart REST operations, including outbound writes that may time out after remote acceptance?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish implementation correctness, but repository evidence does not define the service latency budget, multipart exception, or retry semantics for an ambiguously accepted write.

options.title: Approve the fixed policy
options.body: Accept the 30-second JSON deadline and multipart exemption as the ClickClack transport contract, then merge with the documented ambiguous-write behavior.

options.title: Retune before merge
options.body: Choose a different deadline or separate read and write policies, then update the focused regression and controlled-server proof.

options.title: Pause for service guidance
options.body: Wait for ClickClack service-owner latency and idempotency guidance before imposing a permanent client-side cutoff.

recommendation.title: Approve the fixed policy
recommendation.body: Accept the 30-second JSON deadline and multipart exemption as the ClickClack transport contract, then merge with the documented ambiguous-write behavior.
